cluster_summary: This cluster comprises 26 cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities caused by insufficient handling of user-supplied input. The common flaw is that user input is reflected or stored without proper HTML encoding, sanitization, or validation, allowing injection of arbitrary HTML/JavaScript. Fixes range from adding global input sanitization filters to per-field encoding, input validation, and removal of insecure features like JSONP.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-controlled template text, expression strings, macro content, or rendering parameters into template engines, expression evaluators, macro renderers, or scriptable configuration evaluators. Report code paths where untrusted expression content is evaluated without sandboxing, escaping, allowlisting, or disabling reflective execution features. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 2 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should separate data from templates, sandbox expression evaluation, and disable reflection or method invocation features for untrusted input.

mechanism.missing_guard: untrusted expression content is evaluated without sandboxing, escaping, allowlisting, or disabling reflective execution features
mechanism.name: untrusted template or expression evaluation
mechanism.sink_shape: template engines, expression evaluators, macro renderers, or scriptable configuration evaluators
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-controlled template text, expression strings, macro content, or rendering parameters
mechanism.typical_fix: separate data from templates, sandbox expression evaluation, and disable reflection or method invocation features for untrusted input

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Apply HTML entity encoding (e.g., HtmlUtils.htmlEscape, StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml, custom sanitize function) to all user-supplied values before embedding them in HTML context, either at the controller/model level or in templates.
sub_patterns.name: Output HTML entity encoding omitted
sub_patterns.root_cause: User-controlled data was inserted directly into HTML output (model attributes, template variables, or string concatenation) without HTML entity encoding.
